ModMetaData.name: Dominion
ModMetaData.author: Ketschbopp
ModMetaData.description:
A geopolitical simulation that overhauls factions and diplomacy. It adds a living news feed, diplomacy with treaties, travelling envoys and in-person summits, a Rim Council that passes binding decrees, espionage and covert operations (abstract or played on the target's own map), wars with goals, war score, warbands crossing the world map, occupation, capitulation and cold wars, broadcasting and cultural influence, embargoes, world events such as famines and plagues, and a unification ending in which you lead a planetary Federation.
Dominion ties many mods into one connected world. Economics and Demography and Faction Territories and Vassalage are required. It also connects with Vanilla Outposts Expanded, Visit Settlements, Simple Leadership, RimToll, RimCourt, RimMarket, InterRim Ballistic Missile, Custom Base Framework, Vanilla Books Expanded and Pillage & Plunder when they are installed.
Dominion replaces The News and is not compatible with it.
Early development: not yet tested in game.
